subject: Evidence request: RBAC claim mapping + SCIM reconciliation workplan
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@carebridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@carebridge.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — RBAC claim mapping and SCIM reconciliation

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of our SIG + SOC 2 intake we're collecting concrete artifacts to validate account-to-role mappings and provisioning hygiene. Could you please share the following by EOD Wednesday (3/18)?

- Export of current role assignments (CSV) showing user id, role id/name, source (SCIM/SAML/manual), and last assignment timestamp.
- Sample SCIM sync logs (delta window) covering a recent 48-hour period (masked PII is fine) so we can verify delta behavior.
- A brief note describing how you handle role ownership and min-privilege validation cadence (weekly, monthly, event-driven).

If you have a single tar/zip of the artifacts that works best. We're trying to avoid additional follow-ups before our security review on 3/22.

Appreciate it — Jordan
Security Engineering | CareBridge Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@carebridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — RBAC claim mapping and SCIM reconciliation

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three items; attaching the initial package below.

Quick notes on contents and known gaps:
- Attached: rbac-claim-export-20260314.csv — includes user_id, role_name, source (generated from SCIM provisioning logs where applicable), assigned_by, last_changed_at.
- Attached: scim-sync-sample-opslog.txt — redacted delta traces covering 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-11 (48-hour sample). We removed full email addresses and replaced with hashed identifiers per our redaction policy.
- Attached: minpriv-matrix-draft.xlsx — a working worksheet that maps high-risk roles to owners and the monthly attestation cadence. This is a draft, we flag ServiceAccount-* entries that need additional justification.

Planned follow-up: Rishi will validate the SCIM timestamps and confirm whether the sync logs capture SCIM incremental vs full resync events. Tessa will finalize the attestation cadence doc and provide a short paragraph on ownership rules. We expect to have Rishi/Tessa sign off and return an updated package by end of day Wednesday (2026-03-18).

If you need stronger provenance (e.g., signatures on extracts or additional audit traces), let me know and we'll include them — we can also provide a short recording of a live SCIM delta replay if helpful.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: rbac-claim-export-20260314.csv (CSV, 124KB); scim-sync-sample-opslog.txt (text, 88KB); minpriv-matrix-draft.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request — RBAC claim mapping and SCIM reconciliation

Forwarding CareBridge request and the initial artifacts I attached to Jordan. Action items:

- Rishi: can you confirm the scim-sync-sample-opslog.txt covers incremental_event vs full_sync and validate the timezone normalization we applied? Also please check checksum on the CSV export and confirm it came from the canonical provisioning DB (not a local cache).
- Tessa: please review minpriv-matrix-draft.xlsx, mark roles that require business-owner justification, and draft the 3–4 sentence paragraph that explains attestation cadence and exception handling for emergency role elevations.

Target: internal sign-off and updated artifacts by 2026-03-18 17:00 PDT so I can repackage and send to Jordan. If either of you need more time, call out the blockers here.

Thanks — Kim

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — RBAC claim mapping and SCIM reconciliation

Kimberly,

Received the package — thank you, that was fast and very helpful. A couple quick follow-ups after a brief review:

1) Could you add one example for a ServiceAccount justification (the matrix flagged ServiceAccount-notebook-runner) showing the owner, purpose, and last-access timestamp?
2) For the SCIM logs, would you be able to include one annotated excerpt that explains the mapping between the delta event and the eventual role assignment in the CSV (just 6–8 lines with inline comments)? That would speed up our reviewers.

If you can drop those two items into the same Drive folder this afternoon I'll mark the intake as "complete" and we won't need to circle back before 3/22.

Thanks again — Jordan
